headline.title: AWS us-east-1 stumbles for three hours
headline.quip: Eleven services went down in the AWS region that hosts approximately everything, including the page you’d use to sign in and check. On a Sunday, so only the people paid to notice noticed.
headline.summary: From 3:05 to 6:10 a.m. PST, 11 AWS services in us-east-1 were disrupted, including IAM Identity Center sign-in, sign-ups, Network Load Balancers, Amazon Connect and Kiro; some load-balancer issues lasted until 6:21 a.m. AWS gave no root cause and cited no malicious activity.

reasons: Backfilled during setup and reviewed by the owner.
